svg.text: Building and watching, in one screen
The camera is the level selector. Left rail builds, right panel tunes the selected thing, bottom rail owns lines, levels and overlays.
LMB build | RMB erase | MMB orbit | wheel zoom | Q/E level
footprint 1 x 2 | level B1 | facing W
Line manager: add a line, pick A/B/C stock, then assign
